_readme: Facts published by car park operators on their own websites, read by hand and recorded with the page URL and the date checked. Only what the page says; no guessed heights or fees. Re-check every few months: tariffs change. Match by carParkId or carParkIds (one-stop park_Id or osm:… id). An entry that names an id attaches ONLY to that id; matchNames are then just extra search terms. An entry with no id falls back to matching those names, and should set `near` {lat,lng,radiusMetres} to fence that match to the right place.
